days.title: Central Da Lat
days.morning: Walk around Xuan Huong Lake, eat bánh căn and visit Lam Vien square.
days.afternoon: Da Lat station, the Trai Mat train and Linh Phuoc Pagoda.
days.evening: Da Lat night market with grilled rice paper and soy milk.

days.title: Clouds and tea hills
days.morning: Wake early to chase clouds at Cau Dat tea hills.
days.evening: Chicken hotpot with lá é and an acoustic café.

days.title: Pine forests and waterfalls
days.morning: The pine hills of the Valley of Love and Tuyen Lam Lake.
days.afternoon: Datanla Falls (alpine coaster) and Truc Lam Zen Monastery by cable car.
days.evening: Buy candied fruit and artichoke tea as gifts.

days.title: Langbiang – Cu Lan village
days.morning: Reach the top of Langbiang by jeep.
days.afternoon: Cu Lan village – kayaking and horse riding among the pines.
days.evening: Central Highlands gong music and rice wine.

days.title: French villas – Bao Dai's palace
days.morning: Bao Dai's Summer Palace, the Rooster Church and Hang Nga "Crazy House".
days.afternoon: Van Thanh flower village and Da Lat rose gardens.
days.evening: Coffee at Tung café and Ba Hung grilled pork rolls.
